taiwan_aviation.headline: 漢光42號演習首日 陸戰隊搭CH-47SD直升機北上防護中樞
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於8月5日展開。首日演練中，海軍陸戰隊官兵兵分兩路增援，除陸路長程機動外，部分官兵搭乘2架CH-47SD直升機飛抵台北附近降落，執行中樞防護演練。此外，海軍濱海作戰大隊中午亦於高雄出動機動飛彈車組，開赴指定位置實施待命放列部署。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Han Kuang Drills Begin with Marines Deploying via CH-47SD Helicopters
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: The Han Kuang 42 live-troop military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, for a ten-day period. On the first day of the drills, Taiwan's Marine Corps conducted reinforcement operations using both land and air routes. Specifically, some marines boarded two CH-47SD Chinook transport helicopters and landed near Taipei to perform critical political and economic center protection drills. Simultaneously, the Navy's Coastal Combat Force deployed mobile missile launcher vehicles and control trucks from Tsoying Base in Kaohsiung to tactical positions, enhancing rapid response readiness.

new_information: On August 5, 2026, during the first day of the Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, part of the Marine Corps boarded two CH-47SD transport helicopters and landed near Taipei to execute central defense drills.

The Marine Corps split into two routes to move north for reinforcement, with the main forces traveling overland from Linyuan in Kaohsiung and some forces performing long-distance aerial mobilization via CH-47SD helicopters.
Around noon on August 5, 2026, the Navy's Coastal Combat Force deployed mobile missile vehicle units from Tsoying Base in Kaohsiung.
The Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise began on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for 10 days and 9 nights until August 14.

international_aviation.headline: 亞太航空六月客運量年減百分之一點一 貨運需求保持韌性
international_aviation.summary: 亞太航空公司六月國際客運量達三千零五十萬人次，較去年同期下滑百分之一點一，主因部分區域市場運能縮減與票價上升。同期國際貨運需求以貨運噸公里計算成長百分之三點二，受惠於AI相關半導體與硬體穩定出貨。上半年累計國際客運量一億九千二百五十萬人次，年增百分之三點二。
international_aviation.headline_en: APAC Airlines See June 2026 Passenger Dip; Cargo Demand Stays Resilient
international_aviation.summary_en: Asia Pacific airlines carried 30.5 million international passengers in June 2026, down 1.1% year-on-year, amid capacity reductions and higher airfares following a fuel price spike. International cargo demand measured in freight ton kilometers rose 3.2%, supported by steady AI-related semiconductor shipments. First-half international passengers reached 192.5 million, up 3.2%.

international_aviation.headline: National Airlines完成蘇格蘭至澳洲直飛貨運飛行
international_aviation.summary: 總部位於美國佛羅里達州的National Airlines於2026年8月4日使用波音777貨機，完成從蘇格蘭普雷斯威克機場至澳洲墨爾本的直飛航班。該航程達9,849海里，飛行時間為19小時23分鐘。這趟為客戶Golden Aviation執行的任務，展示了該機型在減少載重下的超長航程能力。
international_aviation.headline_en: National Airlines Completes Nonstop Boeing 777F Flight From Scotland to Australia
international_aviation.summary_en: Florida-based cargo carrier National Airlines completed a nonstop flight between Prestwick Airport in Scotland and Melbourne, Australia, using a Boeing 777 freighter on August 4, 2026. The flight covered 9,849 nautical miles in 19 hours and 23 minutes without any intermediate stops. Operated on behalf of UK-based aviation services firm Golden Aviation, the flight demonstrated the extended range capability of the Boeing 777 freighter when operating with a reduced payload compared to its full-payload limit.

international_aviation.headline: 印度航空任命Tewolde Gebremariam為新執行長
international_aviation.summary: 印度航空任命埃塞俄比亞航空前執行長Tewolde Gebremariam為新任執行長。Gebremariam曾於2011年1月至2022年3月領導埃塞俄比亞航空。塔塔集團與印度航空董事長N. Chandrasekaran表示公司正進入關鍵執行與擴張階段。前執行長Campbell Wilson已於2026年4月7日宣布辭職。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air India Names Former Ethiopian Airlines Chief Tewolde Gebremariam as New CEO
international_aviation.summary_en: Air India has named Tewolde Gebremariam, the former chief executive officer of Ethiopian Airlines, as its new CEO. Gebremariam previously served as CEO of Ethiopian Airlines from January 2011 to March 2022. Tata Sons and Air India Chairman N. Chandrasekaran stated that the airline is entering a critical execution and expansion era. The appointment follows the resignation of former CEO Campbell Wilson, who announced his departure on April 7, 2026, ending a nearly four-year tenure leading the carrier.
